english: Let $f:[-8,8]\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=x^{5}\cos x+|x|\,(8-|x|)\,\big|4-|x|\big|$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\int_{-8}^{8}f(x)\,dx$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:[-8,8]\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=x^{5}\cos x+|x|\,(8-|x|)\,\big|4-|x|\big|$ द्वारा परिभाषित है। तब $\displaystyle\int_{-8}^{8}f(x)\,dx$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $x^{5}\cos x$ is odd: its integral over $[-8,8]$ is $0$. The other term $E(x)$ is even: $\int_{-8}^{8}E=2\int_0^{8}x(8-x)|4-x|\,dx$
solution_full: $O(-x)=-x^{5}\cos x=-O(x)$, so $O$ is odd and $\int_{-8}^{8}O=0$. $E$ depends only on $|x|$, so it is even and $\int_{-8}^{8}E=2\int_0^{8}E=2\int_0^{8}x(8-x)|4-x|\,dx$.

Let $g(x)=x(8-x)|4-x|$ on $[0,8]$. Then $g(8-x)=(8-x)x|x-4|=g(x)$, so by the property $\int_0^{2a}g=2\int_0^{a}g$ (with $a=4$): $\int_0^{8}g=2\int_0^{4}x(8-x)(4-x)\,dx$; on $[0,4]$ the modulus is simply $4-x$.
originality_note: New: a two-level symmetry: the integrand is even about 0 after the odd part is dropped, and the even part is itself symmetric about 4 on [0,8], so the modulus is removed by halving twice (way 5). Closest known: int_{-a}^{a} (odd + even) dx. Different because: the second symmetry (about x = 4) is needed to avoid the casework of the inner modulus.
blueprint_concepts: Property for odd and even functions
Property int(0 to 2a) f(x) dx = 2.int(0 to a) f(x) dx when f(2a - x) = f(x)

concept_use.Property for odd and even functions: x^5 cos x is odd and vanishes over [-8,8]; the remaining part depends on |x|, so it is even and doubles over [0,8].
concept_use.Property int(0 to 2a) f(x) dx = 2.int(0: g(x) = x(8-x)|4-x| satisfies g(8-x) = g(x), so int_0^8 g = 2 int_0^4 g, where the modulus is removed.

stem_review: Read as a student: f has domain and codomain; moduli nested clearly; value 256 checked by quadrature. Answer is a positive 3-digit integer as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Drop the odd part, then use g(8 - x) = g(x) on [0,8] to reduce to a polynomial on [0,4].
justification: Routine chain of two properties and one polynomial integral. Same demand as 2024-P2-Q16 (L2).
